* Framework \& Script Standardization: Establish standardized test script templates, quality benchmarks, and testing guidelines for People Team testers to execute reliably.
* Phase Governance: Define, monitor, and enforce strict entry and exit criteria for major project testing phases prior to production deployment.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Coordinate testing schedules, resource alignment, and execution progress with People Team business process owners.
* Defect Management \& Triage: Lead defect tracking in Jira, facilitate triage sessions between People Team testers and People Tech engineers, and ensure root causes are addressed.
* Mentorship \& Quality Standards: Coach L1/L2 technicians on testing practices and maintain comprehensive test repositories and runbooks in Confluence.


**Qualifications**
**What We’re Looking For (Must\-Have)**
* Test Coordination Expertise: Proven background in QA coordination or technical test leading, specifically defining test scope, entry/exit gates, and script frameworks for large enterprise projects.
* People Platform Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of HRIS/ATS application workflows and sensitive HR business processes (specifically Workday, SmartRecruiters, Absorb, or Visier).
* Leadership Scope: Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional IT/People initiatives, manage project quality risks, and coach junior team members.
* Orchestration Skills: Experience guiding non\-technical stakeholders through structured testing execution while managing defect lifecycles.
* Tooling Proficiency: Deep hands\-on experience managing testing workflows via Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence.


**Nice to Have**
* Exposure to automated testing frameworks, API testing, or workflow automation tools (e.g. Workato).
* QA certifications (e.g. ISTQB) or technical certifications in Workday or related enterprise HR software.


 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

title: Engineer II, Software (RPA)
description:
**The Opportunity** 




 Ensemble Health Partners is one of the fastest\-growing revenue cycle management companies in healthcare. Our Automation \& AI Platform team is building the next generation of intelligent automation: moving beyond traditional rule\-based bots into agentic, AI\-driven automation and Computer Use Agents (CUA) that can see, reason about, and operate real applications the way a person does. We are looking for an Engineer II who lives and breathes Python and wants to build production automation at the intersection of RPA and applied AI. You will design and ship automations across web, Citrix, and document\-heavy workflows, then push them further with LLMs, OCR, and agentic techniques so they handle the messy, unstructured cases that classic RPA cannot. We care about how you reason about brittle real\-world systems, write clean Python, and learn quickly. Our stack spans Python, Playwright, Azure, Docker, and a fast\-growing agentic / CUA layer built on Azure OpenAI and open\-source LLMs. Strong engineers pick up the parts they haven't seen fast.
 



**Role \& responsibilities** 



* Design, build, test, and maintain production automations in Python across web, Citrix, and API\-driven workflows.
* Automate applications end to end: web automation (Playwright or Selenium), Citrix and virtual\-desktop automation, and OCR or document\-based automation.
* Build agentic and Computer Use Agent (CUA) automations that combine LLMs with UI control to handle tasks that rule\-based bots cannot.
* Apply document processing and intelligent data extraction, blending OCR with LLMs to turn unstructured inputs into structured, usable data.
* Integrate REST and SOAP APIs (auth, pagination, retries, error handling), preferring API\-driven steps over fragile UI wherever an API exists.
* Handle unattended\-execution concerns: secure secret handling, MFA such as TOTP, scheduling, structured logging, and graceful recovery.
* Package automations as Docker containers, run them on Azure, and ship through Azure DevOps Git with PR review and CI/CD pipelines.
* Write and optimize advanced SQL against SQL Server for data\-driven automations and reporting.
* Contribute to our shared automation platform, building reusable workers, connectors, and workflow components.
* Instrument what you build with structured logging, metrics, and Application Insights, and help triage and resolve production issues.



  





 What Were Looking For
 **Minimum 4 years of professional experience building and running production automations or software, with Python at the center of your work.** 




 Must\-Have Skills
 


* Python (required): strong core Python (data structures, OOP, exception handling), clean modular code, virtual environments and dependency management (pip / poetry / uv), HTTP and API work (requests / httpx), parsing JSON, CSV, and Excel data, logging, and writing tests.
* Hands\-on RPA delivery: production automations built in Python. Prior Power Automate / Power Automate Desktop experience is valued, and experience with any other RPA tool (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism) is welcome, but Python is mandatory.
* Web, Citrix, and OCR automation: Playwright or Selenium for web, image / vision techniques for Citrix and virtual desktops, and OCR for documents.
* REST API integration: consuming third\-party APIs with auth flows, pagination, retries, and error handling.
* Advanced SQL: SQL Server / T\-SQL, complex joins, window functions, stored procedures, and query tuning.
* Azure fundamentals, hands\-on with: Service Bus, Key Vault, Function Apps, Application Insights, Automation Runbooks, and Azure AI Foundry.
* Docker: containerizing automations and running them reliably.
* Git and CI/CD: Azure DevOps pipelines, PR workflow, and branching.
* Unattended\-run fundamentals: secrets, MFA / TOTP, scheduling, and logging.



  





 Preferred / Stand\-Out
 


* Agentic automation and Computer Use Agent (CUA) experience: combining LLMs with UI control to build adaptive automations.
* AI / LLM engineering: Azure OpenAI, prompt design, and handling non\-deterministic output.
* Open\-source LLM experience: self\-hosting or serving models (for example vLLM) and integrating them into automation.
* Document processing at scale: intelligent extraction from PDFs and scanned documents using OCR and LLMs.
* FastAPI \+ Pydantic: building small services and APIs that sit behind automations.
* Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool / adapter abstractions.
* Healthcare / regulated\-data domain: familiarity with HIPAA constraints or Epic / FHIR integration.



  





**Why Choose Ensemble India?** 




 People First, Last \+ Always
 



 We believe in putting people at the heart of everything. Our culture is rooted in collaboration, growth and innovation—where your contributions are valued, your voice is heard and your potential is nurtured.
 



  





**A Place to Thrive** 




 Whether you're just starting out or looking to grow your career, Ensemble India is a place where you can do your best work and be your best self. We offer structured career paths, paid professional certifications, tuition reimbursement and mentorship opportunities to help you advance.
 



  





**Comprehensive Total Rewards**

 • Healthcare coverage for associates and their immediate families including parents

title: Quality and Project Platform Lead
description:
Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) and Vitamins, Minerals and Supplements (VMS) market globally.
 



  





 Our mission is to bring health in people's hands by making self\-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide, and counting.
 



  





 At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world's most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
 



 B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 You will lead a team of 5 to 10 experts and platform owners covering three connected areas:
 



 Digital Quality, meaning GxP processes, computer system validation, and the Digital Control Framework.
 



  





 Testing and quality engineering, including test strategy, test management and automation on Xray and Tricentis Tosca.
 



  





 The Atlassian platform, where Jira and Confluence on Atlassian Cloud carry project delivery, documentation and compliance evidence for Opella Digital.
 



  





 The role is both platform owner and people manager. There is no intermediate management layer, so you lead senior specialists directly and stay close enough to the work to challenge a validation rationale, review a test automation approach, or settle a Jira workflow design.
 



 We are looking for someone with 12 to 15 years of experience who owns the outcome rather than the task, simplifies processes that have grown complicated, and works comfortably across Digital, Quality and the business functions.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  





**Lead the team** 




  





 Line manage 5 to 10 experts and platform owners, including internal staff and partner resources. Set direction and priorities across three areas at once. Give each platform owner clear accountability, decision rights and a roadmap they own, then hold them to it. Run objective setting, performance and development conversations, coaching, and skills, backup and succession planning. Shape resourcing, capacity and the balance between insourced and partner\-delivered work. Own the budget and vendor relationships for the platforms in scope. Build one team culture across quality, testing and platform engineering rather than three separate groups.
 



  





**Digital Quality, policy and validation governance** 




  





 You are the global owner for GxP\-relevant Digital Quality policies, standards, SOPs and work instructions, and for making them usable in practice. You own the Digital Control Framework: control design, control ownership, testing of control effectiveness, evidence retention and remediation tracking.
 



  





 The role covers controlled document management for CSV and CSA, data integrity under ALCOA\+, cloud and SaaS governance, and electronic records and electronic signatures under 21 CFR Part 11\. Digital solutions must meet GxP, ICH, HIPAA and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, including how protected health and personal data is handled across regulated and commercial systems.
 



 You provide quality oversight for computer system validation using GAMP 5 and CSA principles, take risk\-based decisions and document the reasoning. You govern validation plans, risk assessments and test strategies, and you review and approve URS, functional specifications, UAT reports, validation summaries and Authorization for Use. You manage validation deviations and CAPAs, oversee change controls for validation impact, and run GxP periodic reviews. You also govern digital supplier management: vendor inventories, assessments, quality agreements and performance monitoring.
 



  





**Testing, strategy, tooling and delivery assurance** 




  





 Own the global test strategy and testing standards for Opella Digital across functional, integration, regression, performance and user acceptance testing, in both GxP and non\-GxP systems. You are accountable for Xray as the test management layer in Jira and for Tricentis Tosca as the automation platform, covering roadmap, licensing, environments, upgrades, integrations and adoption, working through the platform owners in your team.
 



  





 Grow automation coverage on the systems that matter most, such as ERP, supply chain, commercial and web, and make automated evidence usable for validation where the regulations allow it. Keep traceability intact from requirement to test case to execution to defect, which serves delivery quality and inspection readiness at the same time. Set testing metrics such as coverage, defect leakage, automation rate and cycle time, and use them to change how the teams work. Get involved early enough with project and product teams that testing is planned in from the start rather than added at the end.
 



  





**Atlassian platform** 




  





 Own Jira and Confluence on Atlassian Cloud, along with Jira Service Management, the Marketplace app portfolio and the integrations with the rest of the digital toolchain. Define and govern project templates, workflows, schemes, permissions and space structures so that they support agile delivery and the traceability a regulated environment needs.
 



  





 Cloud releases arrive continuously, so the platform roadmap has to cover release and change management, app rationalization, performance, cost and license optimization. Work with Cybersecurity, Identity and Internal Audit on security, privacy, access management, data residency and audit requirements, including the controls needed for Jira and Confluence to hold GxP\-relevant records. Drive adoption and standardization across Digital and the business so the standard way is also the easy way, and run platform operations to agreed service levels with a clear support model and incident and problem management.
 



  





**Collaboration, audit and inspection readiness** 




  





 Partner with Digital, Manufacturing, R\&D, Quality and Supply Chain teams to give GxP and testing guidance during system modernization. Work with Cybersecurity, Data Privacy and Internal Audit specialists so requirements are managed in one central framework rather than several. Build and deliver global training on digital and GxP policies, data integrity, validation, testing and Atlassian practices.
 



  





 Keep evidence packages and stakeholder coordination ready for audit at any time, not only when one is announced. Act as the subject matter expert during Health Authority inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA and others) and internal or external audits covering digital systems, validation and data integrity, and lead CAPA development and effectiveness checks for findings related to digital quality governance.
 



  





**About you** 




  





 We look at potential, character and culture fit alongside experience.
 



  





 You have 12 to 15 years of experience across digital quality and compliance, software testing and platform ownership in a regulated industry such as pharma, healthcare or life sciences.
 



 You have managed people for at least 3 to 5 years, ideally senior specialists and platform owners in a flat structure, including hiring, coaching, performance management and leading work delivered through partners.
 



  





 You have owned an enterprise SaaS platform yourself, including its roadmap, budget, vendors, lifecycle, adoption and service levels.
 



  





 You know test strategy, test management, automation and the validation lifecycle for GxP digital systems.
 



  





 On tooling, you have worked hands on with Jira and Xray for test plans, executions, traceability matrices and dashboards. You understand how Tricentis Tosca automation is designed, maintained and scaled in a large system landscape. You can configure and govern Jira and Confluence Cloud, including workflows, permissions, apps and admin and security controls. You are familiar with ServiceNow, Veeva Vault or equivalent document management systems.
 



 On regulation, you know GxP, ICH guidelines, HIPAA and 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records and signatures, together with GAMP 5, CSA, IT general controls and ALCOA\+ data integrity principles. You have run GxP supplier qualification activities.
 



 You are fluent in English and comfortable working with stakeholders across a global matrix organization.
 



  





**The Opella leadership behaviors we are looking for** 




 We assess every candidate against our four behaviors.
 



 Behavior What it looks like in this role All in. Together. You lead one team across quality, testing and platforms, and you partner across Digital, R\&D, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, asking for help and giving it freely. Courageous You challenge how validation and testing are done today, take considered risks on automation and platform change, and speak up during inspections. Outcome\-Obsessed You own the compliance and delivery result, not only the task, and follow through with integrity and speed. Radically Simple You make GxP frameworks and platform configurations simple enough for teams to understand and apply.
 



*Opella is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every candidate feels respected.*

title: Principle SDET
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
   

  

**About The Technology Organization**
 Technology at Lilly builds and operates mission\-critical digital products and platforms that support the discovery, development, and delivery of medicines that make life better for people around the world. Our teams operate in highly regulated, high\-availability environments, where operational excellence, reliability, and quality are non\-negotiable.
   

  

 Within Tech@Lilly, the Digital Core organization applies a product, platform, and reliability\-first mindset, ensuring that operational capabilities scale sustainably across the enterprise.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Tech@Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using pioneering technologies like the most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Lilly IT is that we redefine what's possible through tech to advance our purpose, creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, including data\-driven drug discovery, connected clinical trials, resilient enterprise platforms, and intelligent digital operations. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver creative solutions in every area of our business.
   

  

 The Digital Core team leads Lilly's transformation into the Digital and AI era. They inspire digitally empowered teams to new ways of working and accelerate innovation and agility. This team powers and advances the entire company by building and maintaining world\-class technology capabilities and platforms.
   

  

 Lilly Capability Centre India (LCCI), Hyderabad, is Lilly's premier Global Technology Hub, harnessing data, AI, analytics, and digital solutions to revolutionize healthcare and improve patient outcomes worldwide.
   

  

 The Reliability Engineering team is the engineering\-first function that owns operations, incident response, runbook automation, and the safe evaluation of agentic remediation across a multi\-application production estate. This role sits inside that team and owns test engineering for the work it ships, partnering closely with the peer engineering team that builds the agentic automation platform.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 As a Principal Software Development Engineer in Test, you own the quality bar for the Reliability Engineering function and act as the shift\-left engineering partner across the wider application support organization. You are an engineer first and a tester second. You write code, you build test frameworks, you instrument quality signals into pipelines, and you raise the engineering standard for everything that ships through the team.
   

  

 This is not a manual QA role and it is not a role that catches defects late. You move quality left into design reviews, code reviews, CI gates, and observability, and you build the automated test machinery that lets a small engineering team ship agentic runbooks, remediation logic, and operational platforms with confidence. You are the engineer the team relies on to make sure what reaches production has been engineered for verifiability from the start.
   

  

 You partner with the senior reliability engineering leads, the agentic platform engineering team, and the senior architect. You are the single named owner for test strategy across your function, and the consulting voice on quality engineering across the wider organization.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Shift\-left test engineering and design partnership
* Embed in design reviews and architecture conversations before code is written. Raise testability, observability, and failure\-mode questions early, and make sure the answers are engineered in, not bolted on.
* Define the test strategy for each platform, runbook, or agent the team ships, including unit, contract, integration, end\-to\-end, and behavioural tests for agentic and AI\-augmented components.
* Set the quality gates that releases must clear in CI, and own the conversation when a gate blocks a release. The gates exist because you defended them.
* Test automation framework engineering
* Build and maintain the test automation frameworks used across the reliability and agentic engineering teams. Engineers consume what you build; you do not write tests case by case for them.
* Engineer test harnesses for agentic systems: deterministic evaluation of agent outputs, regression suites for prompt and policy changes, golden\-set comparison, and replay\-based testing for runbook automation.
* Build contract tests between the agentic automation layer, the observability platform, the ITSM system of record, and the applications they act on, so changes on either side surface in CI rather than in production.
* Build chaos and resilience tests that exercise failure paths the team would not otherwise see until an incident.
* CI/CD quality gating and pipeline ownership
* Own the quality stages in the team's CI/CD pipelines, including static analysis, security scanning hooks, coverage thresholds, performance regression checks, and gating policies.
* Drive shift\-left static analysis, security linting, and dependency\-risk checks into pull\-request workflows, and tune them so they catch real issues without becoming noise.
* Engineer pre\-production environments that mirror production sufficiently to validate runbook automation and agentic actions safely, including data masking, synthetic traffic, and replay harnesses.
* Quality observability and signal engineering
* Treat observability as a testing surface. Engineer test signals into OpenTelemetry instrumentation so the same telemetry that runs production also validates correctness in lower environments.
* Build dashboards and queries (Splunk or equivalent) that surface quality signals — escaped defects, flaky tests, coverage drift, agent decision accuracy — to engineering leads and senior technology leadership.
* Validate SLO instrumentation in partnership with the reliability engineering leads, including burn\-rate alerting tests and synthetic probes.
* Regulated\-environment readiness and audit\-grade evidence
* Engineer test evidence that holds up under GxP, SOX, and HIPAA scrutiny: traceability from requirement to test to result, repeatable runs, signed artefacts, and change\-controlled test assets.
* Partner with the validation and quality functions on computer system validation expectations for operational platforms and agentic remediation, and translate those expectations into automated checks where possible.
* Make sure the test estate itself is treated as code: versioned, reviewed, and deployed through the same pipelines as production software.
* Quality leadership across the organization
* Act as the consulting quality engineer for the agentic platform engineering team and the broader reliability function when those teams need shift\-left advice or framework support.
* Coach engineers in writing the tests that should ship with their code, and raise the engineering bar on test design through code reviews.
* Mentor junior engineers and operational anchors on test automation skills as part of the team's capability uplift.


**How You Will Succeed**
 At the principal level, success is defined by leverage and by the quality of what reaches production:
   

  

* You ship test frameworks and CI machinery that other engineers reuse, not isolated test suites tied to one project.
* Defects that should have been caught in CI are caught in CI; the ones that escape are rare, well\-understood, and inform the next gate you build.
* Agentic and automated remediation in production behaves the way the team said it would, because you engineered the evaluation that proved it.
* The team writes more tests, not because they are told to, but because the frameworks you built make doing the right thing the easy thing.


**Required**
**What you should bring**
* 10\+ years of professional engineering experience, with at least 5 years specifically in test engineering, SDET, or quality engineering roles where you owned automation frameworks and CI quality gates, not just test execution.
* Hands\-on engineering background in Python and at least one of Java, TypeScript, or Go, with the kind of fluency where you ship the test framework yourself rather than specify it for someone else.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with at least two major test automation stacks (for example: pytest plus a suitable end\-to\-end framework, Playwright or Selenium for UI, Postman/Newman or REST Assured or schemathesis for APIs, Locust or k6 for performance).
* Strong CI/CD engineering background, including authoring pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or equivalent), designing quality gates, and tuning them so they remain useful rather than ignored.
* Working fluency with a modern observability and ITSM toolchain — Splunk or equivalent for observability and quality signal surfacing, ServiceNow or equivalent as the system of record, Terraform for infrastructure\-as\-code, at least one major public cloud (AWS preferred), and OpenTelemetry for instrumentation.
* Demonstrated shift\-left practice: participation in design reviews, contract\-first development, test\-driven or behaviour\-driven development at meaningful scale, and a point of view on where shift\-left pays off versus where it adds friction.
* Experience operating in a regulated or audited environment (GxP, SOX, HIPAA, PCI, or equivalent), with comfort around change control, audit evidence, and validated\-system constraints.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related engineering field.


**Preferred**
* Hands\-on experience testing AI\-augmented or agentic systems, including evaluation harnesses, golden\-set regression, prompt and policy drift detection, and human\-in\-the\-loop validation patterns.
* Experience contributing to chaos and resilience testing programs (AWS Fault Injection Service, Gremlin, LitmusChaos, or equivalent) tied to measurable reliability outcomes.
* Familiarity with computer system validation (CSV) and GxP test documentation expectations in pharma or life sciences technology environments.
* Background in performance and load engineering, including baseline\-and\-regress practice and the ability to defend performance targets with data.
* Mentoring engineers on test craft and influencing peers without org\-chart authority through code, design reviews, and engineering documents.
* Formal certifications welcome but not required, such as ISTQB Advanced, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or equivalent.


**Leadership expectations**
* Leads through code, frameworks, and design reviews — not through ceremony.
* Treats test code with the same engineering rigour as production code.
* Holds the quality bar consistently and without it becoming political, even when a deadline is in tension with a gate.
* Brings shift\-left thinking into rooms where it is not yet the default, and earns the right to be heard there by doing the engineering work.
* Operates as the named quality\-engineering owner for the reliability function, and as the consulting voice on quality across the wider organization.


**Additional Information**
 Availability to work flexible work hours is/may be required. This team supports continuous operations and may require non\-standard work hours, including some work on weekends and holidays. Appropriate adjustments in benefits will be provided for employees working non\-standard hours where applicable.
   

  

 This is an onsite role based in Hyderabad. Candidates should be open to working with global delivery partners across time zones, with occasional shift flexibility when production\-critical validation work requires it.

 We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. * AI\-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed\-systems literate. High\-efficiency, event\-driven, low\-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.

**The role:**

title: Applied AI Platforms Engineer II
description:

**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Platform Engineer II**
**Role Overview:** 
 As an Applied AI Platform Engineer II , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands\-on approach to building the platforms, tooling, accelerators, and frameworks that other engineering teams build on. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering platform capabilities that delight the engineers who depend on them, while driving tangible leverage and value across Deloitte’s AI engineering investments. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering\-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per\-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high\-quality, lean designs and implementations.
* Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.
* Maintain accountability for the integrity of the platform architecture and for the enterprise tech\-stack conformance baseline that engineering teams build against. Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy\-as\-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry\-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift\-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands\-on, self\-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high\-quality, supportable, scalable code to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability\-by\-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved.
* Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning\-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption\-validated increments rather than big\-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable.
* Work collaboratively with empowered, cross\-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible\-by\-design and submit them for admission, co\-defining service\-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
* Possess expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure—internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy\-as\-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale—including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self\-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
* Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use\-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance\-as\-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
* Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well\-structured arguments and trade\-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
* Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co\-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.


**The team:** 
 US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost\-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom\-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting\-edge internal and go\-to\-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.
   

  

**The successful candidate will possess:**
* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.


**Required Qualifications:**
* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
* 5\+ years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory), , C\#, .NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing frameworks \& tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium.
* 3\+ years of experience designing, building, and operating AI/ML platform or infrastructure, with hands\-on experience across building tooling for MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, and eval/observability instrumentation for LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open\-source models).

* Prior experience using methodologies \& tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, and ArgoCD to deliver high\-quality platforms and products rapidly.

description:
**About Us** 




 Our mission is simple: we want to help our customers solve complex business matters using easy digital solutions. We have passionate and technologically savvy people working here, we’re proud of the awards we have received, but the trust we get every day from our 2000\+ customers means more than anything!
 



 Our growth and success are driven by the passion and dedication of everyone in the organization. We have expanded into an international team with offices in the Netherlands, India, and Italy, and a presence in the United States and Australia. Our motivated team members are the driving force behind our success.
 



**What You'll Do:** 




 We are seeking an experienced Senior Functional Consultant – Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations (F\&O) to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will possess strong functional expertise in D365 Finance and be responsible for ensuring that product enhancements, customer\-specific customizations, change requests (CRs), and defect fixes are validated against business and functional requirements before release.
 


* Validate Change Requests (CRs), enhancements, and defect fixes against business and functional requirements.
* Collaborate with Product Owners and Services teams to understand requirements and define test strategies.
* Create and maintain business scenarios, test plans, test cases, and functional test suites.
* Maintain requirement traceability and manage test execution in Azure DevOps.
* Execute functional, integration, regression, and release testing to ensure product quality.
* Review functional specifications and acceptance criteria to improve solution quality and testability.
* Investigate, reproduce, and validate defects, working closely with development teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Perform impact analysis and validate fixes across end\-to\-end business processes.
* Ensure QA standards and release readiness criteria are met before sign\-off.
* Track testing progress, defects, and quality metrics, providing regular stakeholder updates.
* Continuously improve testing processes, documentation, and reusable test assets.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools to enhance requirement analysis, test design, and functional validation.



**What You Need to Be Successful:** 



* Minimum 5–8\+ years of experience as a Functional Consultant or Functional QA Consultant in Microsoft Dynamics AX / Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations (F\&O).
* Strong expertise in D365 F\&O Finance modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash \& Bank Management, Procurement, Inventory, Sales, and related business processes.
* Experience in business process analysis, functional solution design, and end\-to\-end D365 F\&O implementations.
* Solid understanding of Supply Chain Management processes, including Procurement \& Sourcing, Inventory, Production, Sales, and Advanced Warehouse Management.
* Hands\-on experience in functional, integration, and regression testing, with the ability to design comprehensive test plans, business scenarios, and functional test cases.
* Experience validating integrations, data migration, and end\-to\-end business processes.
* Proficiency in Azure DevOps for work item management, test execution, defect tracking, and release management.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in requirement analysis, manual testing, defect management, root cause analysis, and regression validation.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 F\&O certification is preferred.
* Experience with AI\-assisted testing tools for requirement analysis, test design, defect investigation, and productivity improvement is a plus.

title: Application Development & Support Senior Analyst
description:
**Role Statement**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Senior RPA, Automation \& AI Analyst is a senior technical specialist within the ERP Tech Factory's Automation Factory pillar, accountable for driving process automation and operational efficiency across the global enterprise. This role leads the end\-to\-end design, development, and deployment of scalable Robotic Process Automation (RPA), broader automation solutions, and AI\-powered tools that eliminate manual effort, reduce error rates, and accelerate business process performance.
   

  

 Acting as the technical lead for automation and AI initiatives, this role owns architectural decisions, defines development standards and reusable frameworks, and ensures solutions progress from proof\-of\-concept through to globally standardised, production\-grade deployments. The Senior Analyst mentors junior team members, leads technical reviews, and actively partners with ERP Second Level Support, Third\-Level Support Engineers, and Software Development/Platform Engineers to ensure automation solutions are aligned with platform architecture and business priorities.
   

  

 As a senior contributor to the ERP leadership ecosystem, this role is expected to proactively identify and prioritise automation and AI opportunities, build compelling business cases, and drive measurable outcomes in the context of the organisation's Run, Enhance, and Converge operating model.
   

  

**Key Duties**
**Automation \& AI Solution Design \& Delivery**
* Lead the end\-to\-end design, development, and deployment of complex RPA, automation, and AI\-powered solutions across business functions and ERP/enterprise platforms.
* Own architectural decisions for automation and AI solutions, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise technology standards.
* Drive adoption of automation and AI solutions across business functions, partnering with stakeholders to embed tools within operational workflows.
* Manage the full automation and AI solution lifecycle from ideation and requirements gathering through build, testing, deployment, and post\-launch optimisation.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate automation and AI platforms, tools, and technologies (e.g., UiPath, Power Automate, WePath, GenAI tooling) to address business requirements.


**Scalable Asset Development \& Governance**
* Build and maintain a library of reusable automation components, AI solution assets, and standardised development templates that accelerate delivery across the team.
* Define, document, and enforce development standards, coding best practices, and reusable frameworks for the Automation Factory.
* Ensure all automation and AI solutions are governed through appropriate version control, documentation, and release management practices, including CI/CD pipeline integration and ALM tooling.
* Conduct technical reviews and quality assurance of automation and AI solutions developed by junior team members, ensuring adherence to standards and design integrity.
* Monitor deployed automation and AI solutions for performance, reliability, and error rates; lead root\-cause analysis and remediation for failures.


**Opportunity Identification \& Prioritisation**
* Identify and prioritise automation and AI use cases by systematically analysing process inefficiencies, manual workload data, error rates, and business impact across functions.
* Lead the development of business cases for automation and AI investments, including effort estimates, ROI projections, and risk assessments to support budget allocation decisions.
* Maintain and continuously evolve the automation and AI opportunity pipeline, ensuring prioritisation aligns with strategic business objectives and delivery capacity.
* Validate assumptions and refine opportunity scoping through structured discovery sessions with process owners and operational stakeholders.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Mentoring**
* Partner with ERP Second Level Support, Third\-Level Support Engineers, and Software Development/Platform Engineers to ensure automation solutions are technically integrated and operationally supported.
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for automation and AI topics with ERP Product Owners, Product Specialists, and business stakeholders.
* Mentor and coach junior RPA, Automation \& AI Analysts, providing technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and supporting their professional development.
* Lead technical design and review sessions, coordinating input from cross\-functional engineering and business teams.
* Communicate solution delivery progress, issues, and outcomes to the ERP Tech Factory Lead and relevant stakeholders in a clear, concise, and timely manner.


**Required**
**Qualification and Experience**
* 5–7 years of combined hands\-on experience in RPA (e.g., UiPath, Power Automate, WePath), process automation, and/or AI tool development in an enterprise environment.
* Proven track record of automating end\-to\-end business processes, including integration with ERP and enterprise platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to take automation and AI solutions from proof\-of\-concept through to globally standardised, production\-grade deployment.
* Strong expertise in RPA, automation tool development, and AI solution integration, including prompt engineering and AI\-powered workflow design.
* Deep understanding of software development and release practices, including CI/CD pipelines, version control, and Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).
* Experience in data modeling, architecting, and documenting automation solutions.
* Ensure coding methodologies and best practices are followed across all automation development activities.
* Strong capability to translate complex business processes and requirements into automation and AI\-ready technical specifications and solutions.
* Solution ownership mindset with full accountability for automation lifecycle management, including performance monitoring and continuous improvement.
* Experience mentoring or technically leading junior team members, with strong communication and knowledge\-transfer skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work independently and drive outcomes in a complex, global organisation.


**Preferred**
* Experience with Oracle EBS or similar large\-scale ERP platforms, including integration touchpoints relevant to automation design.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow and/or Jira Cloud for service management, incident tracking, and agile delivery management.
* Background in complex, multi\-region manufacturing or industrial organisations.
* Exposure to Generative AI tools and frameworks relevant to enterprise automation and operational productivity use cases.
* Relevant professional certifications in RPA platforms (e.g., UiPath Certified Professional, Microsoft Power Automate certifications) or AI tooling.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* Automation coverage rate – percentage of eligible manual processes successfully automated
* Automation execution success rate – bot/solution run success vs. failure rate across deployed automations
* Development time\-to\-deliver – average elapsed time from approved scope to production deployment
* Manual error \& rework rate reduction – measurable decrease in manual processing errors attributable to automation
* Solution reuse rate – percentage of new automations built using shared components or reusable assets
* Mentoring \& knowledge transfer effectiveness – progression of junior analysts and team capability uplift over time
* Business case accuracy – alignment of realised ROI to projected savings and efficiency gains


**About Us**
**The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles \& Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.**
**OUR CORE PRINCIPLES:** 
 Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.
   

  

**OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES**
* High\-Performance Culture
* Customer Focus
* Operational Excellence
* Innovation
* Financial Strength


**VERTIV BEHAVIORS**
* Own it
* Act with urgency
* Foster a customer\-first mindset
* Think big and execute
* Lead by example
* Drive continuous improvement
* Learn and seek out development
* Promote transparent \& open communication


**About Vertiv**
 Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F\-1, H\-1, H\-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.
